name: pellucid-chat-naming
description: Names each Claude Code session from the main agent's own understanding of the task: a stable topic, a numbered phase and a short focus. No extra model call; titles you set yourself are never overwritten.

state_dir.title: Naming state directory (optional)
state_dir.description: Override for the plugin's own ledger directory. Leave empty to use pellucid-chat-naming inside the Claude config directory.

desktop_apply.title: Rename in Claude Desktop sessions
desktop_apply.description: Apply titles when the session is drawn by Claude Desktop. Off by default: Desktop title behavior is not verified.

min_turns_between_updates.title: Answers between focus updates
min_turns_between_updates.description: Completed answers after a title change before the agent is invited to update the focus again.
